Appellate Jurisdiction

Anticipatory Bail Application No.2886 Of 2023
Bhausaheb Gnagaram Shinde ... Applicant
 versus
The State of Maharashtra ... Respondent
Mr. Kuldeep U. Nikam, for Applicant.
Mr. S.H.Yadav, App for State.

Coram: N.J.Jamadar, J.
 Date : 19 October 2023

P.C.
1. Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R.No.195 of 2023 registered with Sinhgad Road Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 417 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The first informant lodged a report with the allegations that since March 2022, the applicant induced her to have physical relations by making promises of marriage.
In the month of March 2023, the first informant got an information which indicated that the applicant was in a relationship with another girl prior to two years.
Upon being contacted, the said girl stated that since two years prior to lodging of the FIR, the applicant had also been promising her to marry with her.
The first informant realized that the applicant was deceiving her.
Hence, the report.

4. The learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant Bhausaheb Gangaram Shinde vs The State Of Maharashtra on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67922515/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Proximity developed and they had a consensual relationship.
On the basis of an unjustified suspicion about the past relationship, the first informant has lodged a false report.
5. Learned APP seeks time to take instructions.
6. Prima facie, it appears that the sexual relations were consensual.
The first informant had her first marriage in the year 2015 and her first husband had passed away.
The tenor of the report indicates that the report came to be lodged as the first informant entertained suspicion about the past relationship of the applicant.

I am,
therefore, inclined to protect the liberty of the applicant.
7.

Hence, the following order :
 ORDER (i) In the event of the arrest of the Applicant -Bhausaheb Gangaram Shinde in connection with C.R.No.195 of 2023 registered with Sinhagad Road Police Station, the Applicant be released on bail on furnishing a PR bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicant shall co-operate with the investigation and report to Sinhagad Road Police Station on 25th, 26th and 27th October 2023 in between 10.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m.

(iii) The Applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and/or give threat or inducement to any of the prosecution witnesses and the persons 903 aba 2886 of 2023.doc acquainted with the facts of the case.
(iv) The applicant shall subject himself to medical examination and surrender his mobile phone handset, if required, before the Investigating Officer.
(v) Stand over to 7 November 2023.
